# Protein-Membrane MD analysis tutorial using BioExcel Building Blocks (biobb): Nextflow

Nextflow version of the [python workflow](../python/workflow.py), with the [BioBB Nextflow modules](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_adapters/tree/master/biobb_adapters/nextflow) it uses copied in `modules/`. Every step runs the BioBB block inside its biocontainer (or bioconda package) with the properties of [python/workflow.yml](../python/workflow.yml).

## Run

From a clone of this repository, with [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/install.html) >=25.10.0 and Docker:

```bash
nextflow run biobb_wf_mem/nextflow -profile docker
```

Profiles: `docker`, `apptainer`, `singularity` and `conda`. Results are written to `results/<id>/<step>/` (`-output-dir` to change it), with files named `<id>_<step>_<role>.<ext>`.

## Inputs

`samplesheet.csv` (`--input`): one row per system, all of them run in parallel. Paths are absolute or relative to the samplesheet folder. The default samplesheet runs the inputs of the python workflow.

| Column | Python workflow input | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | | Name of the run, prefix of the output files |
| `trajectory` | `trajectory.xtc` | step1_gmx_image1, step3_fatslim_membranes, step7_gorder_aa |
| `structure` | `structure.pdb` | step1_gmx_image1, step2_gmx_image2, step3_fatslim_membranes, step4_lpp_assign_leaflets, step5_lpp_zpositions1, step6_lpp_zpositions2, step8_fatslim_apl, step9_cpptraj_density, step10_mda_hole, step11_lpp_flip_flop |
| `topology` | `topology.tpr` | step7_gorder_aa |

## Configuration

`nextflow.config` has the BioBB properties (`ext.properties`) and output extensions (`ext.outputs`) of every step. Change them there or in a config file given with `-c`.

## Steps

| Step | Block | Description |
|---|---|---|
| step1_gmx_image1 | [biobb_analysis/gmx_image](modules/bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_image/README.md) | Fit the trajectory to the membrane |
| step2_gmx_image2 | [biobb_analysis/gmx_image](modules/bioexcel/biobb_analysis/gmx_image/README.md) | Fit again transxy to the protein |
| step3_fatslim_membranes | [biobb_mem/fatslim_membranes](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/fatslim_membranes/README.md) | Membrane leaflets identification and GROMACS index file generatation |
| step4_lpp_assign_leaflets | [biobb_mem/lpp_assign_leaflets](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/lpp_assign_leaflets/README.md) | Assign leafleats for every frame |
| step5_lpp_zpositions1 | [biobb_mem/lpp_zpositions](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/lpp_zpositions/README.md) | Computing z-positions for the whole membrane |
| step6_lpp_zpositions2 | [biobb_mem/lpp_zpositions](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/lpp_zpositions/README.md) | Computing z-positions for the selection around the protein |
| step7_gorder_aa | [biobb_mem/gorder_aa](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/gorder_aa/README.md) | Calculating deuterium order parameter of acyl tails in a lipid bilayer |
| step8_fatslim_apl | [biobb_mem/fatslim_apl](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/fatslim_apl/README.md) | Removing the area corresponding to protein molecules |
| step9_cpptraj_density | [biobb_mem/cpptraj_density](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/cpptraj_density/README.md) | Calculating membrane density |
| step10_mda_hole | [biobb_mem/mda_hole](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/mda_hole/README.md) | Identifying channels and analyze dimensions and properties along them |
| step11_lpp_flip_flop | [biobb_mem/lpp_flip_flop](modules/bioexcel/biobb_mem/lpp_flip_flop/README.md) | Detecting the flip-flop of molecules in a lipid bilayer |
